title: Extending the PRINTcipher Distinguisher to Key Recovery
summary: An invariant-subspace distinguisher is known for weak-key classes of PRINTcipher; whether and how it can be extended to recover the key remains open.

formal_statement.body: PRINTcipher has a distinguishing attack on weak-key classes that is a special case of the general invariant-subspace attack. Determine whether, and by what method, this distinguisher can be extended into a key-recovery attack.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of PRINTcipher using invariant-subspace attacks.
assumptions: The key belongs to a weak-key class targeted by the presented distinguishing attack.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether, and by what method, the existing distinguisher can be extended into a key-recovery attack.

citations.label: A Cryptanalysis of PRINTcipher: The Invariant Subspace Attack

progress.summary: The paper presents the PRINTcipher attack as a special case of the general invariant-subspace attack and explicitly leaves its extension from distinguishing weak-key classes to key recovery as an open problem.
citation_labels: Gregor Leander et al., A Cryptanalysis of PRINTcipher: The Invariant Subspace Attack
